text_block_list.text:
Wild and unpredictable in everything she 
does, Chairwoman Akikawa's love and 
passion for Umamusume are truly second to 
none.

She tells her Trainer that she wants them 
to be the leading force behind the URA 
Finals.

To shoulder the hopes and dreams of 
countless fans—and raise <chrname> into a true 
"Star Umamusume."

To achieve that, we first need to capture 
the hearts of the masses and build up a 
fanbase!
